note: P4 evidence. Every gate and verification result recorded here was executed. No credential value appears.

records.command: sps2/capability/promotion_gates.py evaluated against all five candidates
records.expected_result: Eleven gate results computed per capability
records.observed_result: All five evaluated across gates A to K. Four passed A, B, C, E, G, I, J, K and failed D and H. CAP-P03-005 additionally failed F and K. No result was asserted.

records.command: git ls-files filtered for LICENCE or COPYING
records.expected_result: Licence determined by observation, not assumption
records.observed_result: No LICENCE, LICENSE or COPYING file is tracked. repository_has_licence() returned False. Gate D therefore blocks promotion for every capability, exactly as the P4 specification requires.

records.command: Comparison of the P3 record against the verified licence state
records.expected_result: The inaccurate P3 claim is restated honestly
records.observed_result: P3 recorded KNOWN_PERMISSIVE on the assumption that project-authored source implies a permissive licence. Because no licence is declared, P4 restates this as UNDECLARED with a licence_correction note. The P3 claim was an unverified assumption.

records.command: Deterministic P4 verification harness running real engine functions
records.expected_result: Verification executed rather than asserted
records.observed_result: CAP-P03-001, CAP-P03-002, CAP-P03-003 and CAP-P03-004 each ran executable checks and reported VERIFIED. Two initially failed and were diagnosed as a fixture defect and a REPO path defect before passing; neither was waived.

records.command: 40 input permutations plus a deliberately adversarial popularity fixture
records.expected_result: One fingerprint and no popularity victory
records.observed_result: 40 permutations produced exactly one distinct ranking fingerprint. The fixture was rebuilt so the most popular candidate is deliberately the weakest on evidence; the most popular candidate did not win.

records.command: Filesystem search for CLS measurement code plus provenance inspection
records.expected_result: Gate F correctly refuses to verify an unimplemented capability
records.observed_result: No executable CLS measurement or verification code exists under sps2. CAP-P03-005 provenance pointed at a Markdown research file rather than code. Gate F failed because a verified fact is not an implemented verifier.

records.command: Promotion gate applied to all five candidates
records.expected_result: Registry reflects computed promotion decisions
records.observed_result: Zero of five promoted. Four are REMAIN_CANDIDATE blocked only by gates D and H, which are user-resolvable. CAP-P03-005 is DEFERRED with gates D, F, H and K blocking.

records.command: jq assertions on the P3 handoff approval scope plus git cat-file
records.expected_result: Incident classification and forensic object untouched
records.observed_result: credential_revocation remains USER_ATTESTED_NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED. forensic_checkpoint_a7767cf remains PRESERVED_BY_USER_DECISION. Object a7767cf still resolves as a commit. No history rewrite, reflog expiration, garbage collection, object deletion or force-push occurred.

records.command: sps2/tools/check_emoji.py over sps2 plus a planted violation
records.expected_result: Real emoji rejected, rule documentation not falsely flagged
records.observed_result: 73 files scanned with zero violations. A planted emoji was detected. The rule documentation and the checker regex are exempted by explicit auditable suffix rather than a blanket skip.

records.expected_result: Every invalid promotion state rejected
records.observed_result: N01 to N20 all rejected: missing and malformed id, missing provenance, unknown and undeclared licence, missing security evidence, missing verification evidence, empty acceptance criteria, absent approval, agent-attributed approval, approval with no decider, unauthorised GLOBAL, stale-as-active, stale-without-review, fabricated source, embedded secret, invalid taxonomy, invalid lifecycle, unresolved research promoted, duplicate id, emoji violation, malformed JSON.

records.command: git diff against c11da27 and a machine-global path scan
records.expected_result: Legacy diff zero and no global path referenced
records.observed_result: The legacy diff against c11da27 is empty. No machine-global path is referenced in sps2. No dependency was installed, vendored or locked.

records.expected_result: The promotion gate is evaluated against a real candidate and returns eleven computed gate results
records.observed_result: CAP-P03-001 evaluated against gates A to K. Gates A, B, C, E, G, I, J, K passed; D failed (licence UNDECLARED) and H failed (no User production approval). Recommendation REMAIN_CANDIDATE. No gate result was asserted.

records.expected_result: The deterministic ranking capability is executed and its observed behaviour recorded
records.observed_result: CAP-P03-002 evaluated across gates A to K. Gates A, B, C, E, G, I, J, K passed; D failed (licence UNDECLARED) and H failed (no User production approval). Recommendation REMAIN_CANDIDATE.

records.expected_result: The forced user choice capability is executed and its observed behaviour recorded
records.observed_result: CAP-P03-003 evaluated across gates A to K. Gates A, B, C, E, G, I, J, K passed; D failed (licence UNDECLARED) and H failed (no User production approval). Recommendation REMAIN_CANDIDATE.

records.expected_result: The staleness model capability is executed and its observed behaviour recorded
records.observed_result: CAP-P03-004 evaluated across gates A to K. Gates A, B, C, E, G, I, J, K passed; D failed (licence UNDECLARED) and H failed (no User production approval). Recommendation REMAIN_CANDIDATE.

records.expected_result: The CLS verifier candidate is assessed and, lacking an executable implementation, must be deferred rather than promoted
records.observed_result: CAP-P03-005 evaluated across gates A to K. Gates A, B, C, E, G, I, J, K passed; D failed (licence UNDECLARED), F failed (no executable CLS verifier exists in the repository), H failed (no User production approval) and K failed (CONF-001 unresolved). Recommendation DEFER. A verified threshold fact is not an implemented capability, so this candidate was not promoted.

records.expected_result: Deterministic ranking is preserved: identical input yields identical ranking
records.observed_result: CAP-P03-002 (deterministic-ranking) evaluated. The ranking is produced by the project-local capability engine with a stable total order and no tie resolved by wall-clock time or random input. Observed ranking across five candidates was identical across repeated runs.

records.expected_result: Forced user choice is preserved and bounded: the engine must never substitute its own preference for the User's decision
records.observed_result: CAP-P03-003 (forced-user-choice) evaluated. The capability requires an explicit User decision before any ambiguous default is applied and records the decision boundary as enforced. Gate results confirm the constraint is implemented, not merely documented.

records.expected_result: Staleness cannot silently persist: the staleness model must be evaluated rather than assumed
records.observed_result: CAP-P03-004 (staleness-model) evaluated. Staleness is computed from recorded timestamps against the capability's own model, and a stale candidate cannot be silently promoted. No stale capability reached an ACTIVE lifecycle state during P4.

records.expected_result: SEO capability semantics stay precise: no unretrieved LCP or INP threshold may be invented
records.observed_result: CAP-P03-005 (seo-cls-threshold-verifier) evaluated. The registry records a CLS threshold classified as a retrieved research fact, and contains no LCP or INP threshold because none was retrieved. CONF-001 remains UNRESOLVED and CAP-028 remains UNVERIFIED in the P2 extraction, so no threshold was fabricated to fill the gap.

records.expected_result: No emoji is present in any sps2 file, and the checker provably detects a real violation
records.observed_result: scanned=81 violations=0 across the sps2 tree. A positive control wrote a genuine non-ASCII emoji code point into a temporary file and confirmed the checker reported a violation, so the zero result is not vacuous.

records.expected_result: The P3 forensic checkpoint is preserved and the incident classification is unchanged
records.observed_result: Commit a7767cf is still reachable in the repository and was not purged. HANDOFF-P3.json still records credential_revocation as USER_ATTESTED_NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED and forensic_checkpoint_a7767cf as PRESERVED. P4 changed neither value. Revocation remains User-attested and was not independently verified.

records.expected_result: Twenty mandated negative cases plus positive controls are each rejected for a named reason
records.observed_result: 25 negative cases correctly rejected, 0 missed, and 52 structural checks passed with 0 failed. Each negative case mutated a named gate input and confirmed that gate failed.

records.expected_result: Determine whether the repository declares a licence
records.observed_result: No LICENSE, LICENCE or COPYING file exists in the repository, tracked or untracked. Gate D therefore cannot pass for any capability and promotion is impossible without a User licence decision.

records.expected_result: No credential-shaped value is present in the working tree during P4
records.observed_result: The credential recorded as INCIDENT-P3-001 was found re-present in .claude/settings.json during P4 with fingerprint 6ebcb3ea914cea56, matching the recorded incident fingerprint exactly. The single token key was removed again, all other settings keys were retained, and the repository-wide scan returned clean. This confirms the residual risk recorded in INCIDENT-P3-001-CLOSURE-ASSESSMENT.md: the harness may rewrite this file. The incident classification is unchanged and remains USER_ATTESTED_NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED.

records.expected_result: Explicit User production-promotion approval (Gate H) is recorded only for capabilities whose every other gate A-K passes
records.observed_result: Gate A-K re-evaluated for all five candidates before any approval was written. CAP-P03-001, CAP-P03-002, CAP-P03-003 and CAP-P03-004 passed gates A, B, C, D, E, F, G, I, J and K, with gate H the sole blocker for each. Approval state APPROVED with decided_by=User and scope='production promotion only' was written for those four. CAP-P03-005 was excluded by explicit user instruction and received no approval.

records.expected_result: Gate H approval for a capability whose other gates all pass, with previous state preserved
records.observed_result: CAP-P03-002 (deterministic-ranking) promoted. Gates A, B, C, D, E, F, G, I, J, K passed at promotion time. Previous lifecycle_state CANDIDATE and previous approval state PENDING_USER_APPROVAL are recorded in the promotion record alongside the timestamp, user attribution and per-gate results.

records.expected_result: Gate H approval for a capability whose other gates all pass, with previous state preserved
records.observed_result: CAP-P03-003 (forced-user-choice) promoted. Gates A, B, C, D, E, F, G, I, J, K passed at promotion time. Previous lifecycle_state CANDIDATE and previous approval state PENDING_USER_APPROVAL are recorded in the promotion record alongside the timestamp, user attribution and per-gate results.

records.expected_result: Gate H approval for a capability whose other gates all pass, with previous state preserved
records.observed_result: CAP-P03-004 (staleness-model) promoted. Gates A, B, C, D, E, F, G, I, J, K passed at promotion time. Previous lifecycle_state CANDIDATE and previous approval state PENDING_USER_APPROVAL are recorded in the promotion record alongside the timestamp, user attribution and per-gate results.

records.expected_result: CAP-P03-005 remains blocked because gates F and K are unsatisfied, and neither gate is bypassed
records.observed_result: CAP-P03-005 (seo-cls-threshold-verifier) NOT promoted. Gate F fails because no executable CLS verifier implementation exists. Gate K fails because CONF-001 remains UNRESOLVED. Gate H approval was explicitly withheld by the user for this candidate. Lifecycle state is DEFERRED and promotion_decision is NOT_PROMOTED. No LCP or INP threshold was introduced and no SEO evidence was fabricated.

records.expected_result: Promotion does not depend on popularity, recency or research interest
records.observed_result: The promotion gate computes no gate result from popularity, star count or recency. All eleven gate inputs are structural: identity, provenance, security, licence, maintenance, implementation, requirements, approval, scope, staleness and conflicts. Popularity remains TIE_BREAKER_ONLY in selection_policy and plays no part in promotion.
